links.outcome: DL algorithm AUROC/sensitivity/specificity versus 13 clinician graders on same test set
links.effect: Algorithm matched or exceeded all independent clinician graders (AUROC 0.92 with optometrist labels, 0.93 with expert panel labels); clinician sensitivity ranged 0.33-0.99, specificity 0.68-0.98.
links.quote: Algorithm performance matched or exceeded that of all independent clinician graders in detecting patient-level referable glaucoma based on LAC DHS optometrist (AUROC = 0.92) or expert panel (AUROC = 0.93) reference labels.

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a deep learning algorithm for detecting referable glaucoma from fundus photographs in a reader study comparing algorithm performance against 13 clinicians on a retrospective test set.
